message: Fix Dispatcher control-chat bootstrap loop in agent-handoff only. Current runtime evidence: dedicated control URL exists and turn 23 is stuck with last_error='Control chat bootstrap pending'; log repeats every ~90s: 'bootstrap отсутствует' -> resend -> 'bootstrap ... не завершён'. Implement Dispatcher 2.2.6 with these requirements: (1) detect assistant readiness by an explicit CONTROL READY marker, independent of exact full bootstrap user-text matching; (2) detect bootstrap presence by a stable short marker/subsequence rather than exact equality of the entire long bootstrap text; (3) persist bootstrap-sent state in .ai-dispatcher-control.json and migrate an existing valid control URL with no flag as already sent, because 2.2.5 saved the URL only after sending bootstrap; never keep resending bootstrap each poll; (4) make control readiness checking non-blocking/short so the main GitHub loop is not blocked for 90 seconds; respect CONTROL_RETRY_SECONDS before rechecking; (5) if CONTROL READY is already present, immediately continue and send the pending GPT wake; (6) preserve wake duplicate protection and Arena behavior; (7) bump both dispatcher.py and dispatcher-runtime.py to 2.2.6; installer must continue to detect version dynamically and verify startup; (8) keep Playwright timeout classification fix; (9) add/adjust tests or at minimum run syntax/import checks and report exact results. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. After committing, write turn_id=25 target=GPT source=ARENA status=ready with commit SHA, changed files, and test results only.
